title: Applied ML experiment scratchpad - 2026-03-08 (Maya)
content:
Goal:
- Quick experiment notes for quantization + prompt-eval runs on Llama-13B variant (candidate for Dedicated SKU). Want a rough sense of quality delta vs int8/bit4 baseline and token throughput on a p4d-like instance profile.

Today plan:
- Run eval harness (qa + summarization prompts) on:
  - fp16 (baseline)
  - int8 (bitsandbytes)
  - 4bit GPTQ (gguf conversion)
- Collect: accuracy/ROUGE, p50/p95 latency (single-request, 512 context), tokens/s for batching (batch sizes 1/4/8), mem usage, and qualitative failure modes.

Prompt sets (local copies in s3 above):
- prompt_set_qasim_v2.json: 120 QA pairs, domain general 
- prompt_set_summ_short_v1.json: 80 news summarization and TL;DR tasks
- quick-adversarial-10.txt: hand-curated adversarial prompts for hallucination checks

Commands run (notes):
- baseline fp16 (torch):
  CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python run_eval.py --model /models/llama13b/fp16 --prompts prompt_set_qasim_v2.json --batch 1 --context 512 --out out_fp16_qasim.json
  -> p50 210ms, p95 480ms, tokens/s 420 (batch=1). Memory peak ~42GB.

- int8 (bitsandbytes):
  CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python run_eval.py --model /models/llama13b/int8-bnb --use-bnb --prompts prompt_set_qasim_v2.json --batch 1
  -> p50 190ms, p95 430ms, tokens/s 470. Slight drop in exact-match accuracy: 1.8% absolute. Memory peak ~25GB (good).

- 4-bit GPTQ (gguf) quick run:
  python run_eval.py --model /models/llama13b/gguf-4bit --gguf --prompts prompt_set_qasim_v2.json --batch 1
  -> p50 170ms, p95 360ms, tokens/s 540. Accuracy drop larger: ~4.7% absolute on QA (bad on numeric reasoning). Memory ~18GB.

Observations so far:
- Int8 bitsandbytes gives best cost/quality tradeoff for general QA: small accuracy regression (~2%) but good throughput and stable outputs.
- 4-bit GPTQ is very promising throughput-wise but degrades on reasoning / multi-step QA; check if mixed-precision kv-cache or calibration helps.
- Summarization (short) seemed more robust to quantization: ROUGE-L change <1.5 for int8, ~3.2 for 4-bit.

Quick qualitative examples (from adversarial set):
- Prompt: "List all US presidents born in the 19th century."
  - fp16: correct list (good).
  - 4-bit: missing Chester A. Arthur, hallucinated extra name "John T. Morgan" (false).
- Prompt: arithmetic chain (novel): 17*23 - 19 =>
  - fp16: 372
  - 4-bit: 368 (off-by-one-ish), int8: 371

Next experiments to try (immediate):
- Re-run 4-bit with post-GPTQ quantization config "--calib-samples 1024" (check stable kernels).
- Try KV cache in fp16 while weights in 4-bit (hybrid) to see if reasoning improves. Config: --kv-mixed-precision fp16
- Run small-batch throughput: batch sizes 4 and 8 for int8/4bit to measure tokens/sec scaling and tail latency.
- Produce side-by-side answer diffs for the 120 QA set and mark types of failures: hallucination vs omission vs wrong-fact.

TODO (short-term):
- [ ] Run gguf 4-bit with calib + kv-hybrid by EOD (assign: Maya).
- [ ] Share a short summary w/ runtime numbers in #eng-serving-runtime and tag Jamie for cost guidance.
- [ ] Open a GH issue capturing weird hallucination case for 4-bit and link to sample outputs (PR template).
- [ ] Add the best int8 profile to quant-profile registry (confluence doc) if accuracy loss <2.5% and tokens/s improvement >10%.

Open questions / flags:
- Does Dedicated SKU use bitsandbytes (64-bit ptr) runtime? We need to confirm library compatibility on the production runtime (SRE). Tag Jamie.
- Are there known issues with gguf conversions for this Llama-13B checkpoint (previous PR had a conversion flag mismatch)? See GH PR 145.

Quick notes for report:
- If int8 maintains <=2% QA delta and reduces per-token memory by ~40%, likely good candidate for Dedicated cost tier.
- 4-bit attractive for cold-start throughput but requires careful QA and potential fallback to int8 for certain routes (reasoning-heavy).

Links / refs (local):
- JIRA ML-1023: quantization eval ticket
- Confluence: inference/quant-profiles (draft)
- GH PR 145: gguf conversion fixes

Personal log / time: started 09:20, baseline runs until 11:05, int8 11:20-11:50, quick 4-bit 12:10-13:00. Need to re-run 4-bit with calibration because some outputs changed across runs (non-deterministic behavior observed).

Notes to self (short):
- Save the run seed and python env: venv-pt1-2026-03-08 (pip freeze saved to s3 path).
- If memory OOM for fp16 when running batching tests, use model offload or switch to a p4d-xlarge.

If I get clean reproducible 4-bit with calib and kv-hybrid, add to "optimize" doc as experimental profile (tag: experimental-4bit).

-- Maya
